suite: the Groups switches (the map's containers on both models, the grid's assemblies on the fixture)
expect_red: [real] a choice stored before the Assemblies switch existed shows the assemblies

mutations.contract: The store keeps the kinds switched off, so a choice stored before the assemblies had a switch reads them on.
mutations.note: A stored choice that does not mention the assemblies reads them off -- the shape a store of the kinds switched ON would have -- and a reader's old Parts-off hides every outline.
